asked.item: Mix six images and one video in a single LinkedIn carousel
Posting via the API to a company page

verdict.reason: The pages state that videos cannot be mixed into a LinkedIn carousel, that carousels use 2-10 JPG or PNG image URLs, and that pageId goes in the target object for a company page.

steps.text: No, videos cannot be mixed into a carousel.
For a carousel, pass 2-10 image URLs (JPG, PNG) in content.mediaUrls, and Blotato auto-builds a LinkedIn Document carousel.
To post to a company page, add pageId in the target object.
